capability.summary: Forward authorized canonical messages individually or as bounded encrypted chat records, preserving destination identity and retry-safe acceptance.

invariants.name: Source admission rejects protected, recalled and expired messages and resolves canonical order; target access and current session authority remain required at acceptance.
Forward batches bind stable request identities and preserve accepted item identities across partial retry and restart; attachments are independently restaged.
Merged records contain bounded versioned display snapshots and contained attachment bytes; recipients validate them without access to source conversations.

escalation: Run frontend/e2e/forwarding.spec.ts for single/multi/merged selection, preview, recipients, cancellation and failed-only retry; run related Favorites and protected-message scenarios. Encrypted loopback account/group transfer, independent attachment readback and restart/idempotency are required for forwarding changes. Native context-menu, keyboard and save-dialog acceptance is separate from browser IPC substitutes; old-client .mtchat attachment fallback requires compatibility evidence.

Network membership mode validates public policy/certificate before installation mutation and persists public files without authority private keys. Policy changes/renewal require restart; startup must bind the certificate to the existing device identity. Windows installer changes require native PowerShell execution in addition to macOS fixtures. Managed services must use main TCP 47479. Managed service discovery must use dedicated UDP 47478 and shared LAN UDP 47474 on all hosts; reject other installer values before mutation. Preserve mesh identity, credentials, custody data and service configuration during updates. macOS local-build updates must retain the installed code-signing identifier and verify the staged signature before replacement; publisher-issued signatures remain intact. See docs/post-office-macos-service.md. Validate real service restart, LAN multicast and routed discovery on the affected host; fixture tests and listener checks do not establish local-network access. Interface handoff changes require the opt-in Docker network-namespace harness: queued and new messages must converge with authenticated receipts without process restart or manual rescan; namespace evidence is separate from physical Wi-Fi hardware.

Release policy is owned by docs/updates.md. Stable publication remains explicit and tag-only; daily/manual main-only Nightly uses immutable vBASE-nightly.RUN.ATTEMPT prereleases, never latest, after exact-source hosted CI. Every desktop and relay platform must pass signatures, provenance, native installer metadata, downloaded draft digest/identity checks and source recheck before publication. Local fixtures do not establish signed hosted-native or actual publication evidence. Version projections require the owning check and standard SemVer source/Nightly/Stable identity tests. Manual draft/maintenance changes require hosted evidence for explicit main-only preparation, unpublished draft-only creation, exact tagged build dispatch and reviewed next-target PR creation; local mocks do not prove those settings and actual preparation/publication requires explicit release intent. Nightly changes require a hosted main workflow run and checking stable latest remains unchanged; stable container publication retains its existing gate.

Optional macOS/Windows delta publication requires SDK full-version authentication of prior canonical payloads, exact native representation equivalence, production Rust decoder round-trip, complete signed metadata savings of at least 25 percent and 1 MiB, and ZIP/standalone digest and provenance acceptance. Actual Windows complete NSIS installation/restart and transferred delta bytes require native hosted evidence; executable-only patches and fixture success do not establish acceptance. Linux remains canonical full update only.

capability.summary: Maintain one Cargo product target, curated version notes and reviewed version/next-target PRs, publishing complete exact-source verified Stable releases and immutable automatic main-branch Nightlies.

invariants.name: Linux x64 and ARM64 release builds retain the Ubuntu 22.04 glibc baseline; compiled Cargo caches are isolated by runner identity, and actual public AppImage launch remains required upgrade acceptance evidence.

Nightly preflight waits at most four hours for missing or pending exact-source checks; completed unsuccessful checks, scanning alerts and API errors fail immediately. Final publication remains an immediate strict source recheck.
Stable publication remains explicit; Nightly is opt-in, main-only and never latest, with all platform assets verified before visibility; desktop packages omit optional packs and edition suffixes.
Cargo owns the numeric target; checked projections never rewrite unrelated versions. Source, Nightly and Stable build identities follow SemVer, and Nightly targets exceed published Stable.

Ordinary main pushes create no release proposals. Explicit main-only Stable preparation validates canonical version, curated notes, historical provenance, exact-source CI and immutable tag/draft state before mutation; next-target PRs retain the existing final publication gate without direct main pushes.

Stable notes require one nonempty exact-version CHANGELOG section; Nightly never borrows another version. Templates retain download/installation/source verification, GitHub automatic product notes are disabled, and release-state reads revalidate cached responses.

Optional free updater signing binds the full logical build version; standalone native payloads and signatures must match the verified ZIP and form a complete platform matrix. Missing keys keep the manual path; partial signing configuration fails closed.

Optional macOS/Windows delta assets preserve the canonical full updater, authenticate at most two eligible installed-executable bases with the existing SDK full-version signature, round-trip exact native targets through the production decoder, and pass complete signed metadata savings, installer equivalence and standalone provenance checks before publication.

escalation: Changes to shared validation/PR infrastructure require its affected workflow diagnostics; this development plan does not replace preflight, health or protected CI. Supervisor Rust thread-policy changes also require full workspace consumers and the real Cargo thread-policy fixture; preserve explicit Windows/sanitizer caller limits.
Changes to health or CI entry points also require the affected workflow diagnostic tests.

Fast PR creation checks source integrity; use --full-preflight for comprehensive local preparation. Required CI must pass before merge; focused diagnostics alone do not certify native or platform execution.

Shared compiler, dependency or feature inputs invalidate every workspace consumer. Inspect production/test feature differences, platform checks and native requirements before merge or full local preparation.

Run actionlint and affected workflow regressions. Mutation runner changes also require scripts/release/run-mutants.test.mjs with the pinned cargo-mutants and cargo-nextest tools; verify both selection preflight and execution. Portable diagnostics and frontend coverage belong to Health; native lint/build/test coverage belongs to CI. PR/merge-group mutation acceptance requires real pinned-runner contract tests; daily/manual deep runs require full sample completion, strict report validation and bounded per-test/per-suite execution. Size the overall mutation job from observed selected counts and build/test timings; see docs/testing-feedback-loop.md#ci-ownership-and-browser-sharding. Source-level workflow checks do not replace actual hosted execution or branch-protection configuration.

Direct check migration requires successful current-source app-bound replacement evidence before editing branch protection; preserve strictness and unrelated checks. Windows libtest partition changes require real Cargo runner and coverage fixtures, exact inventory union and hosted Windows execution; unknown tests remain serial. Linux CI owns instrumented backend scenario evidence, while macOS/Windows retain their dedicated backend jobs.
Public help content is bundled into the frontend and published independently; review the public help build/publication and settings-navigation consumers.
Context selection integrity checks validate rubric inputs; they do not execute the evaluated capabilities or establish native evidence.

Full Chromium shards on Linux, macOS and Windows produce portable core evidence once, with exact four-shard source/run/attempt/platform identity and complete 76-case inventory. Revalidate PNGs, traces and scenario identity on collection, rejecting missing, duplicate, skipped or flaky cases. Dedicated WebKit and extended/Firefox acceptance remain separate. Standalone Windows portable-runner batches remain at most 20 scenarios; run actual hosted Windows full shards to establish timing and acceptance. See docs/testing-feedback-loop.md.

Native harness and evidence-validation changes require fresh real desktop acceptance on the affected platforms with clean source and verified build provenance; diagnostic unit checks cannot certify native behavior.

Installed sticker candidate acceptance uses node scripts/diagnostics/native-sticker-acceptance.mjs after a clean source-pinned native-build.mjs build. It uses two isolated native profiles and production ZIP import/source registration, checks independent missing/installed/replaced transfers plus repeated-send identity and retained bytes, and does not certify native older-peer or linked-device alias behavior.
